scope: Three new USD service-part price observations for Savox SC0252MGP and O.S. MAX-55AX. Seller offers and exact model crosswalks are recorded separately from installation identity, crash repairability, allocation, and repair outcomes.

usd_observations.product: Top & bottom servo case with screws for SC0252MG
usd_observations.price_basis: 1 top-and-bottom case set with screws; the page does not specify screw count.
usd_observations.availability: Servos.net product page displays Add to Cart and a quantity control; it does not state an on-hand quantity. Savox USA's indexed case collection marks this SKU Sold Out, but that collection result is several months old, so present stock is unresolved.
usd_observations.evidence_quality: Direct seller product page fetched 2026-10-16 shows the exact part name, USD 5.49 price, quantity control, and Add to Cart. Current stock quantity is not disclosed; an older Savox USA collection snapshot says Sold Out.

service_compatibility.status: The Savox SC0252MGP product page explicitly lists CSC0252MG in its Spare Parts section. Its listed part name is for the base SC0252MG; the documented placement on the SC0252MGP product page is the exact model crosswalk used here.
service_compatibility.part_listing_name: CSC0252MG - Top & Bottom Servo Case with Screws, for SC0252MG

usd_observations.allocation: Unallocated. No Savox SC0252MGP installation or aircraft position is established.
usd_observations.limitations: A case set price does not establish that an impact-damaged servo can be repaired or that its electronics, motor, gears, or calibration remain serviceable. Tax and shipping are excluded.

excluded_candidate.part: Savox SGSC0252MG gear set with bearings
excluded_candidate.reason: Savox SC0252MGP lists SGSC0252MG under Spare Parts, but Savox USA's replacement-parts listing marks the gear-set offer Sold Out. No current available USD offer was verified, so it is not one of the three price candidates.

integration_limits: These are price candidates only. Add a service-part offer to a repair calculation only after inspection identifies the damaged part and the matching installed model.
Keep service-part prices separate from complete-unit replacement prices; do not charge both for the same component.
No aircraft allocation, repair probability, labor, inspection fee, serviceability finding, or salvage credit is supported by these listings.
Do not transfer MAX-55AX part fit to the historical MAX-61FX or to FS-64V. The Savox crosswalk applies only to SC0252MGP as explicitly listed on that model's Spare Parts section.
